description: Google Ads keyword ideas for up to 20 seed keywords: up to 100 ideas, highest search volume first, with monthly volume, CPC, competition and top-of-page bid range (optional monthly history), in 94 countries, from Google Ads data, $0.16 a call. Use when planning a paid or SEO keyword list from Google's own planner. Over the source's 12 calls a minute: a free 503 with Retry-After. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.16 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

includeMonthly.description: Add each idea's monthly search volumes.

keywords.description: Seed keywords (1-20; each at most 80 characters; one that cannot be looked up is listed in missing).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Defaults to en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

locationCode.description: Google Ads location code (geo target ID). Defaults to 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States, market.fallback).
